desc: Continue paired AppleT6040PCIe static tracing after ticket 068 proved clkgen PLL lock but reg[3]+0x90 still hangs. Resolve every remaining operation before the first _readPhyIPReg, especially PHY-IP power/reset/domain ownership, against ADT indices and exact accessors. Produce a proof/no-go or one separately gated candidate; no rig, no guessed offsets, and never retry 068 unchanged.
progress: 2026-07-26 (done/2026-07-26-t6040-pcie-initializephy-trace.md): decoded _initializePhy's first hardware op = PhyCommon reg 0x0 bit-0 RMW; accessors show shared PHY aperture with PhyCommon at +0x4000, PhyPhy at +0x8000, PHY-IP base cached at this+0x240 (068 hang is a non-responding aperture, not a null ptr). Read /arm-io/apcie0 over the live proxy: no reg-names (index-mapped), 35 entries = 7 header + 4 ports x 7. Resolved absolute addrs: reg[2]=0x217000000 shared PHY => PhyCommon[0]=0x217004000, PhyPhy=0x217008000, op-115 PHY-IP read=0x217048090 (port0, +port*0x8000). Grounded missing precondition: set bit0 of 0x217004000 + PhyPhy setup at 0x217008000 before reading 0x217048090; m1n1 does neither. REMAINING (needs attended session, not autonomous): live PHY-aperture read risks ungated-SError wedge (NVMe class); exact PhyPhy reg/val pairs + second PhyCommon write; definitive dtRegMapApcieCommonIndex(reg[1]) via probe-time ivar fill; then one separately-gated m1n1 candidate. 068 stays un-retried. | 2026-07-26 LATE, THREE FINDINGS + A CORRECTION. (1) m1n1 NEVER WRITES any PCIe register on T6040: pcie_apply_local() routes to tunables_apply_local_trace() when pcie_regs==&regs_t6040, so every tunable is LOGGED not applied — hence 'T6040 AXI trace dry run complete; no PCIe MMIO'. PCIe is stubbed, not failing, so the remaining work is a bounded change to let specific tunables apply. regs_t6040's indices are independently confirmed by today's live ADT read (rc=1/phy=2/phy_ip=3/axi=4 vs reg[1]=0x214000000, reg[2]=0x217000000, reg[3]=0x217040000, reg[4]=0x216000000). (2) OP-115 IS A PLL-LOCK POLL, not an arbitrary read: the captured trace contains 'apcie-phy-ip-pll-tunables[0] read-only addr=0x417040090 size=4 mask=0x1 value=0x1' — poll bit 0 until it reads 1. So it hangs waiting for a bit that never comes up, which fits 068 (clkgen locks a PLL but not this bit), and a bare read of it is harmless — the earlier SError fear was unfounded. (3) CORRECTION: the absolute addresses I published earlier today are WRONG. Trace says PhyPhy 0x417008000 and PLL poll 0x417040090; I published 0x217008000 and 0x217048090 — a +0x200000000 alias. The OFFSETS from the disassembly (+0x8000 PhyPhy, +0x90 PLL) are confirmed exactly; only the base was wrong. AIC reports 1/2 dies so a die/alias offset is the likely cause but is NOT established. NEXT, needing no new authorisation because it writes nothing: extend the TRACE to confirm the full phy-ip-pll/auspma/cio3pllcore sets (only 1 PLL and 14 cio3pll lines appeared, possibly truncated) and resolve the 0x216/0x416 base question from the ADT. Do NOT enable writes blind — a masked RMW to a wrong PHY base is a real write to an unknown register. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-pcie-trace-mode-and-op115-identified.md. | 2026-07-27 ADDRESS CORRECTION (done/2026-07-27-t6040-adt-ranges-address-correction.md): the 0x217 vs 0x417 gap is NOT a die alias — it is the /arm-io `ranges` translation (bus 0x0 -> parent 0x200000000, size 0x480000000). adt.py .reg returns the untranslated BUS address, so add 0x200000000. DEFINITIVE absolutes: PhyCommon[0]=0x417004000, PhyPhy=0x417008000, op-115 PLL poll=0x417040090 — matching the tunables trace exactly. My earlier 0x217... values were the untranslated reads and are wrong. | 2026-07-28 REFUTATION of the late-07-26 'trace mode' finding (done/2026-07-28-t6040-pcie-trace-mode-claim-refuted.md): tunables_apply_local_trace() traces AND WRITES — tunables_apply_local_addr_internal(path,prop,base,trace=true,write=TRUE); the write-free helper is tunables_trace_local_dry_run(), which nothing in the PCIe path calls. Verified at both live-run commits 85b01036 (07-14, ops 1-114 incl. all five apcie-phy-tunables APPLIED) and e4671e08 (07-24 ticket 068, applied again + clkgen PLL lock) — op-115 hung BOTH times WITH the tunables applied. The 'T6040 AXI trace dry run complete; no PCIe MMIO' line came from the 07-14 zero-write log-buffer CONTROL binary (cc8b0ead), removed again by 0bede592; quoting it as current behavior was the error. CONSEQUENCE: 'apply the phy tunables then re-poll op-115' IS ticket 068, already negative, never-retry-unchanged — do not stage an attended session for it. The real open lead is unchanged: the _initializePhy shared-PHY-aperture init m1n1 never does (PhyCommon[0]=0x417004000 bit-0 RMW + PhyPhy setup at 0x417008000); full op-list extraction from the paired kernelcache running 2026-07-28, report due in done/2026-07-28-t6040-initializephy-full-decode.md. | 2026-07-28 LATE — FULL _initializePhy DECODE DONE + D1/D2 CANDIDATE BUILT (done/2026-07-28-t6040-initializephy-full-decode.md, done/2026-07-28-t6040-pcie-d1d2-candidate-preflight.md). Key corrections: (1) the 07-26 'first op = PhyCommon[0] bit-0' was the predicted bl-attribution skew — the first op is PhyPhy[0]|=1, which m1n1 ALREADY does (CLK0REQ); (2) 'op-115 is a PLL-lock poll' is also wrong — _applyTunablesFromData has no poll semantics, the phy-ip-pll-tunables[0] entry is a plain RMW setting bit0 of 0x417040090, and the hang is the READ half on a dead aperture ('read-only'/'poll' wording came from m1n1's own diagnostic label); (3) PortPhyGlue is never touched before port bring-up. Exactly TWO Apple ops precede the first PhyIP access that m1n1 omits: D1 clkgen[0]|=BIT(5) after _configPciePLLs, before the last clock gate (0xfffffe0009b36224); D2 the release clears BIT(4) not BIT(7) (0xfffffe0009b37380). D3 lane-cfg SETTLED OFFLINE: J614s ADT lane-cfg=0, m1n1's write of 0 already correct. D6 (PhyIP[0x90]&=~BIT(16)), D7 (tail bit27 not t8122's 0x200), D8 (poll position) are post-first-access follow-ups. Candidate: m1n1 main 19edc72b / clean 9c35cd2c, binary m1n1-t6040-pcie-d1d2-19edc72b.bin 0e065589c08a6c3186c0bc3eddeae9078a3d878597db60965b88511eb881daad, two byte-identical builds, probe stays READ-ONLY with hard stop before any PhyIP write. GATES: sol exact-artifact review, CJ plan approval, attended run (068 harness). This is NOT a 068 retry: it changes two decoded preconditions.
